builds_on.relation: this development Requires ReversePhysicsTorus and reuses exact_implies_closed and closed

claim_boundary: In a zero-axiom Rocq development kernel-rechecked by coqchk, the four-level chain Hamiltonian <= symplectic <= marginal <= volume-preserving holds at every Fourier mode on T^4, and both inclusions above the topological step are strict, witnessed explicitly. Together with REVERSE_PHYSICS_TORUS_ALL_MODES_ROCQ_V1 the entire inclusion structure of the G1 result is now proved rather than computed.

closes_gate.how: The topological step was already proved for all modes. This adds the other two inclusions, also for all modes, and proves both of them STRICT by explicit witnesses -- an inclusion chain that silently collapsed would make the whole separation vacuous.

does_not_establish: the per-mode DIMENSIONS. The inclusion structure and its strictness are proved; the dimension counts (4, 2, 6, 8-2d per mode) and the totals tabulated in the G1 report remain the Forge gate's exact-rational computation at N <= 3
anything about a general symplectic manifold; the model is the flat T^4 with its standard form
a reproduction, confirmation or refutation of Carcassi--Aidala's own derivation
an equivalence in the reverse-mathematics sense; every theorem here is an IMPLICATION, and no reversal over a base theory exists anywhere in this stream
any quantum, causal, or field-theoretic claim
gate_negative_controls: a FALSE claim that uniform translation is exact at the zero mode is REJECTED by coqc
a FALSE claim that marginal implies symplectic -- which would collapse the chain -- is REJECTED by coqc

next_gate: REVERSE_PHYSICS_REVERSAL: the whole stream proves implications. A reverse-mathematics result needs a base theory and a derivation of an assumption FROM the law. Nothing in this tree has one; that is the standing gap.

structural_result.statement: The marginal condition is EXACTLY the intra-degree-of-freedom content of symplecticity: it is implied by the two closedness equations for the pairs (q1,p1) and (q2,p2), and the four inter-DOF equations it drops are not recoverable from it.
structural_result.why_it_matters: This is the torus counterpart of the linear-carrier finding in the G0 certificate, where the residual obstruction sat precisely in the inter-DOF block J A_12 = -(A_21)^T J. Two structurally different carriers, the same localisation: what a per-degree-of-freedom condition cannot express is inter-degree-of-freedom coupling.

theorems.name: hamiltonian_implies_symplectic
theorems.statement: at every mode, a globally Hamiltonian field preserves omega

theorems.name: closed_implies_intra_dof_closed
theorems.statement: closedness implies its two intra-degree-of-freedom equations

theorems.name: intra_dof_closed_implies_marginal
theorems.role: the sharp form: marginality consumes only 2 of the 6 closedness equations
theorems.statement: the two intra-DOF equations ALONE imply the marginal condition

theorems.name: symplectic_implies_marginal
theorems.statement: at every mode, preserving omega implies each DOF preserves its own area

theorems.name: marginal_implies_volume
theorems.statement: at every mode, per-DOF area preservation implies total volume preservation

theorems.name: the_chain
theorems.statement: Hamiltonian <= symplectic <= marginal <= volume-preserving, at every mode

theorems.name: marginal_not_symplectic
theorems.role: strictness of the symplectic <= marginal inclusion
theorems.statement: X = cos(2 pi q2) d/dq1 is marginal and volume preserving but does NOT preserve omega

theorems.name: volume_not_marginal
theorems.role: strictness of the marginal <= volume inclusion; the torus form of the G0 witness diag(I, -I)
theorems.statement: X = cos(2 pi (q1+q2)) (d/dq1 - d/dq2) preserves total volume but no degree of freedom preserves its own area

theorems.name: marginal_is_exactly_the_intra_dof_content
theorems.role: THE STRUCTURAL RESULT: the marginal condition is precisely the intra-DOF content of symplecticity, and the four inter-DOF equations it drops are not recoverable
theorems.statement: symplectic implies intra-DOF closed implies marginal, and the shear witness is intra-DOF closed but not symplectic
